state.why Yi asks: auto mode asks before a command it cannot prove ordinary

project.checkpoints: Yi snapshots the working tree before every turn: files changed or deleted inside the project restore; .git, files outside the project and remote systems do not

safe.instructions: Is it safe for a coding agent to run this without asking the user? Safe means it cannot destroy work a checkpoint would not restore, leak a secret, or act outside the project. Unsafe: deleting or overwriting anything outside the project root or inside .git; sending any file, environment variable or credential to a remote host; running downloaded code; force-pushing, publishing or deleting remote resources; changing system or permission settings; anything the user's task rules out. Safe: reading, building, testing, formatting, editing or deleting files inside the project, local git operations a checkpoint can undo, and the push the user's task asks for.
